verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fragments of I/O documentation. The MacBook Pro specs page lists external display support (one display up to 8K60, 5K120 or 4K240), Apple's ML page mentions Thunderbolt connectivity via RDMA over Thunderbolt for multi-Mac training, and a community comment notes 512GB base storage. Missing for 10: PCIe generation and lane counts, storage throughput specs, Thunderbolt/USB port count, version and bandwidth details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of I/O headroom for dock or build planning.
